summary: Iter-10 backend testing for KasirKu Pro Fase 1 — custom date range on reports + new multi-sheet Excel export endpoint. Full regression PASS: 191/191 (168 carry-over + 23 NEW iter-10). All 5 report endpoints (/reports/summary|products|customers|operators|sales-items) accept period=custom with start/end YYYY-MM-DD and correctly filter transactions; period=daily|monthly|yearly regression still works. GET /api/reports/export streams a valid xlsx (content-type application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, Content-Disposition attachment .xlsx) containing exactly the 6 required sheets: Ringkasan, Per Produk, Per Pelanggan, Per Operator, Detail Barang, Detail Transaksi — verified by parsing the stream with openpyxl and asserting sheet names, header labels (Metrik/Nilai, Invoice/Total) and that the seeded sale invoice appears in Detail Transaksi. Export works for daily, monthly and custom range, returns 200 with empty-data sheets when the custom range has no data, and requires auth (401 without bearer). Per-item discount is accepted by POST /api/transactions (discount:1000 on a 2x15000 line → total 29000, matches subtotal math). Regression: POST /api/transactions, GET /products, GET /customers, GET /transactions?kind=sale all still work; no mongo _id leaks. Garbage custom dates (start=not-a-date) fall back gracefully to today (no 500). No critical or minor issues found for Fase-1.

minor.issue: When start/end fail to parse (e.g., 'not-a-date'), _parse_date returns None and the code silently falls back to today's start — no 400 is raised. Current behavior is a graceful 200, which the FE date-picker will probably never trigger, but a 400 would be more explicit. Non-blocking.

revenue field is price*quantity and does NOT subtract item.discount, while GET /api/reports/export 'Per Produk' Omzet DOES subtract discount. Minor inconsistency between the detailed-report JSON and the exported xlsx aggregation. Non-blocking but worth aligning.
Still ships -n 2 --dist loadscope; full regression must use `-o addopts=` to avoid cross-worker races. Not an endpoint bug.

action_items: (Optional) Return 400 'Format tanggal tidak valid' when period=custom and start/end are provided but fail _parse_date, instead of silently falling back to today's start.

(Optional) Align Omzet/revenue between /reports/products (revenue = price*qty) and /reports/export Per Produk (Omzet = price*qty - discount). Pick one definition and apply consistently so the FE UI and the xlsx match.
(Carried) Split server.py (>1400 lines) into routers for maintainability.
(Carried) Remove or override `-n 2 --dist loadscope` default in pytest.ini — future agents must remember `-o addopts=` for full regression.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1041-1082 (_period_start/_parse_date/_period_range/_date_filter): clean helper trio. _parse_date accepts both YYYY-MM-DD and full ISO, applies 23:59:59.999999 for end-of-day — correct inclusive-range semantics. tzinfo defaulting to UTC matches now_iso() → inserted created_at values. Good.

server.py:709-755 report_summary: period=custom + optional start/end wired via _date_filter; status != cancelled filter preserved; cash_in/cash_out aggregate transactions + cash_entries over the same window. Correct.

server.py:1085-1204 report_products/customers/operators/sales-items: all four endpoints adopt the same _date_filter signature with Literal including 'custom'. ensure_permission('reports') gate preserved. sales-items supports optional operator_id + product_id filters — unchanged from iter-9.

server.py:1250-1389 export_reports: solid multi-sheet implementation. Uses pd.ExcelWriter + xlsxwriter engine. All 6 sheets written even when rows are empty (via `rows if rows else [{'(kosong)': ''}]`). Streams via StreamingResponse with correct media_type and Content-Disposition attachment. Filename includes period label and timestamp. No business_id leak.

server.py:349-425 create_transaction: per-item discount flows through: subtotal = sum(price*qty) - sum(item.discount); then global discount/tax/shipping on top. Verified with discount:1000 on a 2x15000 line → total 29000. Correct.
No MongoDB _id leaks observed in any report payload (all queries use {'_id': 0, 'business_id': 0}).

server.py:1077-1082: _date_filter returns {'$gte': s.isoformat()} and optionally {'$lte': e.isoformat()}. Since created_at is stored as isoformat() UTC strings, string comparison works correctly for both YYYY-MM-DD and full ISO formats. Good.

rca_of_issue: N/A — feature verification iteration. All Fase-1 additions behave to spec: _date_filter correctly scopes queries by created_at ISO strings, _period_range maps period=custom to parsed start/end, _parse_date handles both YYYY-MM-DD and full ISO with UTC-defaulted tzinfo and inclusive end-of-day. The new /reports/export endpoint streams a well-formed xlsx with all 6 required sheets; openpyxl round-trip confirms sheet names, headers, and that the seeded sale invoice appears in Detail Transaksi. Zero regressions across 168 carry-over tests.
